display.name: Hub · Link workshop
display.description: From shared URL to native preview: unsampled delivery outcomes, provider trouble spots and private source context. Failed download steps stay separate from final results.

display.name: Preview outcomes per minute
display.description: Unsampled terminal counters: one result per considered link, including disabled/policy skips. At most two candidates per message; this is not a count of all shared URLs.

spec.query:
WITH streams AS (
    SELECT time_bucket($resolution, recorded_timestamp) AS x,
        service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid,
        attributes->>'provider' AS provider,
        attributes->>'link.stage' AS stage,
        attributes->>'link.reason' AS reason,
        attributes->>'outcome' AS outcome,
        metric_rate(value, recorded_timestamp) AS n
    FROM metrics
    WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production'
      AND metric_name = 'bot.links.attempts'
    GROUP BY x, service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid, provider, stage, reason, outcome
)
SELECT x, outcome, 60 * SUM(n) AS previews_per_minute FROM streams GROUP BY x, outcome ORDER BY x, outcome

display.name: Delivered previews per minute
display.description: Successful terminal previews by provider. Retries and individual assets cannot inflate deliveries. Empty or stale telemetry is not evidence of zero traffic.

spec.query:
WITH streams AS (
    SELECT time_bucket($resolution, recorded_timestamp) AS x,
        service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid,
        attributes->>'provider' AS provider,
        attributes->>'link.stage' AS stage,
        attributes->>'link.reason' AS reason,
        attributes->>'outcome' AS outcome,
        metric_rate(value, recorded_timestamp) AS n
    FROM metrics
    WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production'
      AND metric_name = 'bot.links.attempts'
    GROUP BY x, service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid, provider, stage, reason, outcome
)
SELECT x, provider, 60 * SUM(n) AS delivered_per_minute FROM streams WHERE outcome = 'success' GROUP BY x, provider ORDER BY x, provider

display.name: How each provider is doing
display.description: Delivery % = delivered / (delivered + failed + declined). Ignored and cancelled previews are separate: unsupported generic yt-dlp links and disabled settings do not reduce delivery %. Counts are unsampled; export loss is still possible.

spec.query:
WITH streams AS (
    SELECT 
        service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid,
        attributes->>'provider' AS provider,
        attributes->>'link.stage' AS stage,
        attributes->>'link.reason' AS reason,
        attributes->>'outcome' AS outcome,
        metric_increase(value, recorded_timestamp) AS n
    FROM metrics
    WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production'
      AND metric_name = 'bot.links.attempts'
    GROUP BY service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid, provider, stage, reason, outcome
)
SELECT provider, SUM(n) AS previews,
    SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'success' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS delivered,
    SUM(CASE WHEN outcome IN ('unavailable', 'timeout', 'unexpected') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS failed,
    SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'rejected' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS declined,
    SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'ignored' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS skipped,
    SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'cancelled' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'success' THEN n ELSE 0 END)
      / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN outcome IN ('success', 'rejected', 'unavailable', 'timeout', 'unexpected') THEN n ELSE 0 END), 0) AS delivered_percent
FROM streams GROUP BY provider HAVING SUM(n) > 0
ORDER BY failed DESC, declined DESC, previews DESC, provider

display.name: Why previews were not delivered
display.description: Terminal failures and declined previews, grouped by provider, last stage and reason. Earlier failed attempts that recovered appear only in the step panels.

spec.query:
WITH streams AS (
    SELECT 
        service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid,
        attributes->>'provider' AS provider,
        attributes->>'link.stage' AS stage,
        attributes->>'link.reason' AS reason,
        attributes->>'outcome' AS outcome,
        metric_increase(value, recorded_timestamp) AS n
    FROM metrics
    WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production'
      AND metric_name = 'bot.links.attempts'
    GROUP BY service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid, provider, stage, reason, outcome
)
SELECT provider || ' · ' || stage || ' · ' || reason AS cause, SUM(n) AS previews FROM streams WHERE outcome IN ('rejected', 'unavailable', 'timeout', 'unexpected') GROUP BY provider, stage, reason HAVING SUM(n) > 0 ORDER BY previews DESC, cause LIMIT 15

display.name: Failed steps · may recover
display.description: Unsampled concrete request/image/video/adapter attempts. One preview can have several failed steps and still succeed; these counts are never added to terminal failures.

spec.query:
WITH streams AS (
    SELECT 
        service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid,
        attributes->>'provider' AS provider,
        attributes->>'link.stage' AS stage,
        attributes->>'link.reason' AS reason,
        attributes->>'outcome' AS outcome,
        metric_increase(value, recorded_timestamp) AS n
    FROM metrics
    WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production'
      AND metric_name = 'bot.links.steps'
    GROUP BY service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid, provider, stage, reason, outcome
)
SELECT provider, stage, reason, outcome, SUM(n) AS steps FROM streams WHERE outcome IN ('rejected', 'unavailable', 'timeout', 'unexpected') GROUP BY provider, stage, reason, outcome HAVING SUM(n) > 0 ORDER BY steps DESC, provider, stage, reason LIMIT 30

display.name: Recent undelivered links · private context
display.description: Terminal logs are emitted independently of trace sampling. Sanitized source links and Telegram identities are private incident context; retain trace/span links when available. Export loss can still hide a record.

spec.query:
SELECT date_trunc('second', start_timestamp) AS time_utc,
    attributes->>'provider' AS provider,
    attributes->>'link.stage' AS stage,
    attributes->>'link.reason' AS reason,
    attributes->>'outcome' AS outcome,
    attributes->>'link.source_url' AS source_url,
    json_get_int(attributes, 'telegram.chat_id') AS chat_id,
    json_get_int(attributes, 'telegram.user_id') AS user_id,
    json_get_int(attributes, 'telegram.message_id') AS message_id,
    json_get_int(attributes, 'telegram.thread_id') AS thread_id,
    json_get_int(attributes, 'http.response.status_code') AS http_status,
    attributes->>'duration_ms' AS duration_ms,
    trace_id, span_id
FROM records
WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production'
  AND kind = 'log' AND span_name = 'bot.link.completed'
  AND attributes->>'operation' = 'links.preview'
  AND attributes->>'outcome' IN ('rejected', 'unavailable', 'timeout', 'unexpected')
ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 40

display.name: Recent failed steps · may recover
display.description: Earlier failures may precede a delivered preview. Follow the trace and its bot.link.completed result before declaring delivery failed or retrying an uncertain Telegram send. Logs are independent of trace sampling.

spec.query:
SELECT date_trunc('second', start_timestamp) AS time_utc,
    attributes->>'provider' AS provider,
    attributes->>'link.stage' AS stage,
    attributes->>'link.reason' AS reason,
    attributes->>'outcome' AS outcome,
    attributes->>'link.source_url' AS source_url,
    json_get_int(attributes, 'telegram.chat_id') AS chat_id,
    json_get_int(attributes, 'telegram.user_id') AS user_id,
    json_get_int(attributes, 'telegram.message_id') AS message_id,
    json_get_int(attributes, 'telegram.thread_id') AS thread_id,
    json_get_int(attributes, 'http.response.status_code') AS http_status,
    attributes->>'duration_ms' AS duration_ms,
    trace_id, span_id
FROM records
WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production'
  AND kind = 'log' AND span_name = 'bot.link.step.failed'
  AND attributes->>'operation' = 'links.step'
  AND attributes->>'outcome' IN ('rejected', 'unavailable', 'timeout', 'unexpected')
ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 40
